title: Fix hasUnsavedChanges() false positive with sticky fields

target.summary: Capturing addNoteFieldBaseline unconditionally after populateEditFields records user-typed text carried over during a note type switch into the baseline. As a result, hasUnsavedChanges() returns false and unsaved input is silently discarded without warning when navigating back.
notes: faulty statement: addNoteFieldBaseline is unconditionally updated here after populateEditFields, capturing user-typed text carried over during a note type switch
check in hasUnsavedChanges relying on addNoteFieldBaseline
